name: LeadGenerator
descriptionForPeople: Find companies to contact, with company-level details only.
descriptionForModel: Find new companies such as new dental clinics in Berlin, look up each company, and keep them in a Leads table. Company-level fields only: name, address, website, phone and category. Never LinkedIn-derived, and no outreach is sent.

operations.name: Find
operations.descriptionForModel: Find new companies matching a query, for example new dental clinics in Berlin.

operations.name: Lookup
operations.descriptionForModel: Look up one company and return its company-level details.

operations.name: Read
operations.descriptionForModel: Read the Leads table of company-level fields.

examplePrompts: Find new dental clinics in Berlin

scenarios.name: Find dental clinics
scenarios.when: I ask for new dental clinics in Berlin
scenarios.then: a Leads window opens with company-level fields only
